manifest.resume_policy: last completed epoch; final epoch evaluated; no test-based selection

no_training_tests.checkpoint_fixtures: Synthetic untrained private format fixtures; never used as experiment results

rng_policy: Original member_seed + fixed dataset offset; seed once per stream; no per-forward reseeding
timing_scope: Checkpoint loading, small audit probes and inference; no dataset preparation/plotting

plot_settings.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-seed density histograms, not raw counts
plot_settings.y_axis: Common limits within each ID/OOD row; rows may differ
